_doc: lightwar arc-projectile grounding tasks. Coordinates in cm (UE units). Launch + target_xy adapted from VeriWorld-benchmark/.../lighting/_parabola_artillery_v2 — 463 m horizontal, 940 cm vertical drop from launch to hill base. Tolerance is 3-D distance from final landing point to the beacon's apex (tower top + light gap).

scene_start_pose._view: launch site, gun-camera looking toward beacon

hit_forest_hilltop_beacon.description: Hit the cylindrical lighthouse beacon on the distant hilltop (light at top of a 8 m tower).

beacon._note: Tower base is on the hill ground; harness raycasts at task start to get exact ground_z at this XY (verified ~2439 in v2 forest, but raycast wins). Light is CYAN at huge intensity + attenuation so the beacon is unmistakably visible from the launch site 463 m away (otherwise atmospheric fog drowns it).
